# Rameswaram Thila Homam

> Authentic Vedic ritual services including Thila Homam, Asthi Visarjan, Pitru Paksha Shradh, Tharpanam, and Kala Sarpa Dosha remedies at Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu.

Rameswaram Thila Homam provides experienced Vedic priests to conduct essential ancestral and pooja rituals, trusted by over 5000+ families.

## Services

- [Thila Homam](https://www.rameswaramthilahomam.com/pooja-homam/thila-homam): Specialized homam performed at Rameswaram for ancestral peace and to remedy Pitru Dosha.
- [Asthi Visarjan](https://www.rameswaramthilahomam.com/pooja-homam/asthi-visarjan): Ritual immersion of ashes in the holy waters of Rameswaram.
- [Pitru Paksha Shradh](https://www.rameswaramthilahomam.com/pooja-homam/pitru-paksha): Dedicated ancestral offerings during the Pitru Paksha period.
- [Thithi](https://www.rameswaramthilahomam.com/pooja-homam/thithi): Annual ancestral rituals based on the lunar calendar.
- [Kala Sarpa Dosha](https://www.rameswaramthilahomam.com/pooja-homam/kala-sarpa): Specific pooja to remedy Kala Sarpa Dosha.
